arithmetic_review: CUDA fp32 is partial mixed-precision placement: CPU complex128 Gram FFT, phase construction, residual projection/rank and covariance preparation remain; PreparedWindowedGaussian.score also uses complex128 whitening and float64 evidence reductions on the selected device. FP32 observation FFT/products and projected likelihood bulk reject TF32. No precision necessity or fully GPU-resident implementation is established.
calibration_review: Strict 1e-4 per day and relaxed 1e-2 per 12 hours are declared stationary proper-complex Gaussian H0 family bounds with 1440 attempts/day, 8 durations, 16 score methods, two bits and separate score/calibration allocations. Every timing/CFO group enters the mixture and residual allocation without group-independence assumption. This signal-only precision comparison does not empirically qualify either tail bound.

limitations: One strong signal at 20 dB-Hz, with accepted score about 410 versus strict gate 22.72; no near-threshold, null or wrong-key arithmetic validation.
Two identical-input repeats per setting are latency/arithmetic replays, not independent correct receptions.
All groups retained rank four and no edge refinement ran; near-singular or refinement precision behavior is untested here.
Only one epoch, clock hypothesis, fractional timing branch and zero drift; no renewed-channel or continuous/fractional timing qualification.
Explicit array bound excludes Python/Torch/driver/allocator overhead; CUDA host RSS exceeds the nominal 1 GiB array budget. VRAM peak is not measured.
No resident multi-capture throughput, multi-GPU acceleration, long-duration performance or sensitivity-equivalence claim.
Original campaign driver hash was not recorded in campaign metadata; this review archives the supplied final driver and verifies its commands/status schema against the retained artifacts.
review_setup_note: Initial read-only review checks stopped before any artifact writes: exact unrounded budget algebra differed from deliberately outward-rounded implementation; a subsequent inline review had a syntax error. The completed check reproduces declared nextafter roundings. No receiver was executed during review.
sampled_rss_scope: Runner samples child VmRSS every 25 ms; this is an observed peak, not a guaranteed maximum or VRAM measurement.
scope: One retained strong-signal capture, six sequential fresh CLI processes; two arithmetic replays per configuration, not independent receptions or resident throughput.
timing_review: Reported total_receiver_seconds starts after workspace preparation. CLI wall includes preparation, imports/startup, input checks and JSON output. Stages are not GPU kernel-event profiles. Two fresh CLI processes per setting share a host/session and can benefit from OS/driver caching.
